source.title: AI is forcing us to pay off 40 years of technical debt
source.author: pseudolus

title.zh: PHP2Shell暴露AI时代的安全技术债
title.en: PHP2Shell Exposes Security Debt in the AI Era

excerpt.zh: PHP2Shell让曾被视为普通崩溃的问题升级为严重安全漏洞。AI辅助专家发现利用路径仅用两周，四名工程师修补却耗时两个月，凸显开源维护压力，也说明发现与修复能力仍不对称。
excerpt.en: PHP2Shell shows how AI can help experts turn overlooked bugs into serious exploits, while fixes demand more time and resources.

text.en: PHP2Shell: From Crashes to Code Execution

text.zh: 据IEEE Spectrum报道，PHP2Shell源于一个早在2024年就已报告的PHP缺陷，此前主要被视为导致程序崩溃的问题。在OpenAI资助的独立审计中，Calif研究人员借助AI工具，在两周内找到了利用该缺陷在服务器上执行任意代码的方法。
text.en: According to IEEE Spectrum, PHP2Shell grew out of a PHP bug reported as early as 2024 and previously treated mainly as a cause of crashes. During an independent audit sponsored by OpenAI, Calif researchers used AI tools to find a way to turn the bug into arbitrary code execution on a server within two weeks.

text.zh: 研究团队向PHP基金会报告后，四名工程师用了两个月开发补丁。报道表示，据当时所知，补丁发布前尚无恶意行为者掌握该利用方法。这说明，一次被低估的崩溃可能隐藏严重风险；发现利用路径与完成可靠修复，所需投入也可能相差很大。
text.en: After researchers alerted the PHP Foundation, four engineers spent two months developing a patch. The report said that, as far as was known, malicious actors had not obtained the exploit before the patch was released. The case illustrates how an underestimated crash can conceal serious risk, and how finding an exploit and delivering a reliable fix can require very different levels of effort.

text.zh: AI安全审计加速，修复能力能否跟上
text.en: Can Remediation Keep Pace With AI Security Audits?

text.zh: 关键限制是，这并非AI独立完成攻击研究的案例。相关研究人员具备深厚的网络安全和PHP知识。AI的作用是帮助专家处理繁琐、细致的推理，使旧缺陷更容易被重新审视并找到利用方式；这也可能加重维护资源有限的开源项目的负担。
text.en: A central limitation is that this was not an example of AI independently conducting exploit research. The researchers had substantial cybersecurity and PHP expertise. AI helped experts handle detailed, laborious reasoning, making old defects easier to revisit and exploit. That capability could increase pressure on open-source projects with limited maintenance resources.

text.zh: 报道提到，增加维护资金、提供安全模型资源，以及结合AI生成补丁与形式化验证，可能帮助防守方缩小差距。但这些方向尚不能证明大规模自动修复已经成熟。眼下的核心问题是：漏洞发现加速后，谁来承担验证、修复和部署的持续成本？对使用者而言，及时安装已有安全更新仍是直接可行的行动。
text.en: The report points to more maintenance funding, access to security models, and AI-generated patches paired with formal verification as possible ways to narrow the gap. These approaches do not establish that automated remediation is ready at scale. The unresolved question is who will sustain the work of validating, fixing, and deploying changes as discovery accelerates. For users, promptly installing available security updates remains a practical step.
